quotes.text: I bought a used Rigol scope with the I2C decoder disabled. Tried to contact Rigol North America for a license quote — they never responded. I'm looking forward to software that makes it the decent tool it should have been.
quotes.author: elevation
quotes.source: Hacker News — OOS – an open operating system for the Rigol Scopes
quotes.extraction_note: Perfect encapsulation of hardware you own having features paywalled by a vendor who won't even sell you the key.
